question: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total runs scored and the top three bowlers with the most wickets taken, excluding ‘run out’, ‘hit wicket’, and ‘retired hurt’ dismissals. In the event of ties in runs or wickets, break the tie using the smaller player ID. Then output these six players in matched positions—batsman 1 with bowler 1, batsman 2 with bowler 2, and batsman 3 with bowler 3—in ascending order of the season ID, along with each player’s total runs or wickets.
sql:
WITH batsman_runs AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.striker
),
extras_runs AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.non_striker as player_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.non_striker
),
combined_runs AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, COALESCE(runs, 0) as runs
    FROM batsman_runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season_id, player_id, COALESCE(extra_runs, 0) as runs
    FROM extras_runs
),
total_runs AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, SUM(runs) as total_runs
    FROM combined_runs
    GROUP BY season_id, player_id
),
batsmen_ranked AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, total_runs as runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) as rn
    FROM total_runs
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, bb.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.bowler
),
bowlers_ranked AS (
    SELECT season_id, player_id, wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, player_id ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_wickets
),
matched_results AS (
    SELECT br.season_id, br.player_id as batsman_id, br.runs,
           br2.player_id as bowler_id, br2.wickets,
           br.rn as batsman_rank, br2.rn as bowler_rank,
           p.player_name as batsman_name,
           p2.player_name as bowler_name
    FROM batsmen_ranked br
    JOIN bowlers_ranked br2 ON br.season_id = br2.season_id AND br.rn = br2.rn
    JOIN player p ON br.player_id = p.player_id
    JOIN player p2 ON br2.player_id = p2.player_id
    WHERE br.rn <= 3
)
SELECT season_id, batsman_id, runs, bowler_id, wickets, batsman_name, bowler_name
FROM matched_results
ORDER BY season_id, batsman_rank, bowler_rank
